response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT o.dealedge, COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot) AS cnt FROM orders o JOIN riskandmargin r ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.dealedge), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM c) SELECT SUM(c.cnt) AS total_count, AVG(c.cnt - a.avg_cnt) AS avg_excess FROM c CROSS JOIN a WHERE c.cnt > a.avg_cnt
